people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: There was no day like that before it or after it, that Yahweh listened to the voice of a man; for Yahweh fought for Israel.
translations.bsb: There has been no day like it before or since, when the LORD listened to the voice of a man, because the LORD fought for Israel.
translations.kjv: And there was no day like that before it or after it, that the LORD hearkened unto the voice of a man: for the LORD fought for Israel.
translations.asv: And there was no day like that before it or after it, that Jehovah hearkened unto the voice of a man: for Jehovah fought for Israel.
